'''Katrina''' (Japanese: '''クミコ''' ''Kumiko'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG157|Time Warp Heals All Wounds]]''. [[Edna]] and {{OBP|Jonathan|AG157}} are her maternal grandparents, and her mother was mentioned briefly.

After running to [[Fuchsia City]]'s abandoned train station to retrieve her grandmother, she also met {{an|May}}. Katrina informed her that Jonathan had left Edna to work in the big city and died there, and that her grandmother had lost a very important pendant during that time.

After May and {{MTR}} rewrote history by unintentionally [[Time travel|traveling back in time]] using Edna's pendant, making sure Jonathan wouldn't leave the town and instead stay with Edna, she reappeared alongside her grandparents as their assistant in caring for [[baby Pokémon]]. At the [[Pokémon Center]], Katrina watched as May's Egg hatched into her {{TP|May|Eevee}}. Because May had altered the past, Katrina didn't remember her from before.
